data.title: bn-24w: Generate consolidated visual diagnostic boards

data.body: [P1] Preflight the complete derived diagnostic board, not only the raw map. The scenario validator knows every selected still size, sequence crop, layer size, view count, review zoom, and (after decode) reference dimensions, yet the 64 MiB aggregate/board checks run only here after all prior stages have executed. For example, a review at zoom=4 with default five views and map region 0,0,128,64 at map zoom=1 passes the new raw-map check (2 MiB), then derives 32 MiB panels and fails only during the final review; equivalent large references and many ordinary sources fail late too. This wastes the deterministic run and contradicts the before-execution validation regression's intended safety boundary. Add a diagnostic preflight that accounts for every panel plus final board geometry using worst-case map dimensions, call it before loading/stepping the cart (after reference decode when needed), and regress with an _init() sentinel proving an oversized derived board never executes.

data.reason: Derived diagnostic panel/board dimensions are not fully preflighted; statically oversized reviews can execute the cart and fail only at the final stage.

data.body: Fixed in the pending patch: review source dimensions, zoomed per-view panel memory, labels, grid geometry, and final-board RGBA are now computed through one shared preflight before project/cart loading. A sentinel _init() regression proves raw-safe but derived-oversized map reviews are rejected before execution; runtime construction uses the same geometry and retains its aggregate defense.

Verified at cc44062. preflight_review runs after bounded reference decode but before project/cart loading, reconstructs exact selected still/sequence/layer labels and dimensions plus worst-case map dimensions, and delegates panel aggregate and final-board geometry to the same diagnostic_geometry used at runtime. The raw-safe/derived-oversized map regression includes an _init() sentinel and passes. Focused results: 16/16 playtest integration tests and 7/7 visual unit tests pass.

data.reason: Fixed and verified at cc44062 with shared geometry preflight and before-load sentinel regression.
